broad_comparison.rate_definition: Actual generated tokens / complete native decode duration, including sampling and speculative work; excludes admission, load, prefill and tools. 512-token cap, normal EOS stopping, high reasoning, recommended sampling. HTTP wall excludes separate token-count request.
broad_comparison.selection_rule: First attempt per prompt/configuration retained as warmup and excluded. First three later resource-qualified requests selected. Opening/closing reference blocks; no timing-based exclusion.
broad_comparison.limitations: Unseeded HTTP requests can follow different continuations and acceptance trajectories. The wire protocol has no seed option. Small sample counts and baseline drift limit causal claims.

gpu_correctness.reference: FP32 matmul of BF16-dequantized weights; relative RMS below0.005
gpu_correctness.packing: Bit-exact inverse permutation of Q8 words/scales/biases
gpu_correctness.fused_activation: Exact versus separate tiled projections and BF16 activation
gpu_correctness.parameter_updates: Final regression passed: Module.update retains array object identity; packed views invalidated/released and current parameters used

components.configuration: Debug diagnostics, not headline generation throughput
components.excluded: Initial components run overlapped compilation; retained privately and excluded from selection.

warmup.initial_failure: Full broad cold warmup hit GPU command-buffer timeout despite isolated kernel checks passing. No other compute or pressure was observed.
warmup.diagnostic: Per-layer materialization followed by full graph passed. Broad warmup now bounds first-use materialization with disposable 1/4-row caches and cancellation checks. Startup speculative warmup uses the recommended sampled preset.
warmup.causality_limit: These observations do not prove the driver-level cause of the initial timeout.

quality.scope: Historical broad comparison at three drafts/four target rows; corrected production results are under channel_correction_followup
